conclusion: The examined evidence contains meaningful recurring repair operations across independent tasks/owners. Existing action-shape batches are semantically heterogeneous and exclude relevant peers. This review proves neither an identical full parameterized procedure nor a promoted L3 skill; automatic semantic discovery and original validation remain necessary.
controls: Keep all 79 representatives as discovery input, not only reviewer-suggested families.
Preserve complete original captures and immutable source references.
Do not replace code changes with arbitrary old/new-text parameters to manufacture recurrence.
A common semantic label is a proposal, not evidence that Gate B passed.
Retain abstention when no shared concrete executable procedure is justified.
